as_told.title: Il Duce's telegram banning mention of an unknown aircraft landing

plain: In 1933, telegrams from Fascist Italy are said to have ordered a total press silence about an unknown aircraft landing on Italian soil, which would mean a government was hiding a UFO case years before the modern UFO era began. The Italian UFO researcher Roberto Pinotti, who wrote a book about it, says on the show that the telegrams relay "the personal order of Il Duce," Benito Mussolini, that "absolutely no mention is to be made of the alleged landing of an unknown aircraft on national soil," and he credits the Stefani agency, the Fascist-era Italian news agency. Michels raises Pinotti's book himself, without naming it, while debating a skeptic.
